sources: R29 sandbox: s20 qubit realisation (1), s21 qutrit realisations (16), s22 CI+Ingleton certificates (18) and the 447 orbits violating an S6 image of the 18 new classes (data/s22_ineq_classes.npy)

status_codes.0: excluded by an exact single-common-information certificate (data/s17_ineq_classes.npy, 747 classes)
status_codes.1: realised (qubit graph-state certificate in data/s16_realisations.npz, qudit certificate in data/s21_qudit_realisations.npz, or BCHS ledger)
status_codes.2: single-CI feasible for all pairs and not yet realised or excluded
status_codes.3: excluded by a CI+Ingleton certificate (R29; data/s22_ingleton_exclusions.json, classes data/s22_ineq_classes.npy)
